coverage: A withdrawn pickup physically retracts its supported load with checked incremental carriage movement before planning from its real travel pose.
Final loaded approach checks the actual chassis, tools, cargo and complete dock turn.
Short swept reverse withdrawal is preflighted with its forward continuation and executed physically before reapproaching.
Late blocked faces can select a checked alternate face of the same reserved footprint.
Curved and turnout top-ups preserve the existing stack bearing, profile and finite capacity.
Atomic save/reload preserves a carried three-panel load, retreat path and reverse gear.
Independent bounded retry intervals prevent repeated path searches and movement-clock starvation.
Completely blocked storage retains real cargo and reports the obstruction until access returns.
scopeLimits: Improves storage-delivery approach planning; it does not automatically relocate otherwise immovable stock.
Impossible layouts remain safely blocked and can use the existing Move to storage feature to relocate obstructing material.
Focused scenarios and regressions are not an arbitrary-layout or large-factory soak guarantee.
Apple Silicon macOS 14+ local app; browser Site remains v0.18.0.
